label: CLIP evaluation ontology
purpose: Describe semantic image-text alignment evaluation and its provenance without treating similarity as a probability or a complete image-quality score.

concepts.label: CLIP evaluation
concepts.definition: Evaluation using aligned image and text embeddings from a CLIP-compatible model.

concepts.label: Image-text similarity
concepts.definition: Similarity between an image embedding and a text embedding.

concepts.label: Prompt alignment
concepts.definition: Relative semantic agreement between a generated image and its intended prompt.

concepts.label: Embedding
concepts.definition: A vector representation produced by a named model and preprocessing pipeline.

concepts.label: Cosine similarity
concepts.definition: Normalized dot product between two embedding vectors.
constraints: Do not interpret as a calibrated probability.
Compare scores only with compatible model and preprocessing configurations.

concepts.label: Evaluation provenance
concepts.definition: Metadata needed to understand and reproduce an evaluation run.

non_goals: Claiming that CLIP alone measures aesthetic quality, factual correctness, safety, anatomy, or temporal consistency.
Comparing raw scores across incompatible models or preprocessing pipelines as if they were calibrated.
